item.title: Report: Jalen Duren Spotted With Trainers Before Sunday’s Checkup
item.description: Detroit Pistons center Jalen Duren is three days from the first real checkup on his right hamstring , and on Thursday he was already out on the practice floor with the training staff. Duren has not played since he strained the hamstring in the second quarter of the Oct. 23 win at Miami. He has appeared in just two games this season, and Detroit is 6-2 . Omari Sankofa II of the Detroit Free Press was at Pistons practice on Thursday. He posted a photo of Duren working off to the side with the trainers. Practice just ended, and Jalen Duren’s here working with trainers pic.twitter.com/fpZVcacU64 — Omari Sankofa II (@omarisankofa) November 5, 2026 Oct 23, 2026; Miami, Florida, USA; Miami Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo (7) protects the basketball from Detroit Pistons center Jalen Duren (0) during the first quarter at Kaseya Center. Mandatory Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) What The Athletic Reported About Jalen Duren’s Hamstring Hunter Patterson, who covers the Pistons for The Athletic , put the next step on the calendar in his recap of Wednesday’s 112-106 loss to the Philadelphia 76ers. “Duren is set to be re-evaluated by the Pistons’ medical staff Sunday,” Patterson wrote. “While they would inevitably be better with him healthy, a silver lining of Duren’s absence is that it’s given more offensive opportunities to players like Robinson .” That lines up with what the team said at the start of this. The Pistons announced on Oct. 25 that Duren would be re-evaluated in two weeks , which puts the appointment on Sunday, Nov. 8. Take the report and the practice work together and Duren could be getting close to a return. The caution is that Sunday is an evaluation, not a clearance to play, and the team has not put a date on him. Getting Duren Back Would Help Detroit It would no doubt help the Pistons to get Duren back into the lineup. In his two appearances this season, he averaged 13.0 points, 7.5 rebounds, 2.0 assists, 1.0 blocks and 1.0 steals . Duren will need to be a huge part of this basketball team moving forward. Being back out there with the trainers is a good start.

item.title: Browns urged by ESPN to make trade QB help in what would be a disastrous move
item.description: Browns urged by ESPN to make trade QB help in what would be a disastrous move originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The 2026 season for the Cleveland Browns , through eight weeks, has been a resounding success. They sit at 5-3, and while there is undeniably still a question about the future of the quarterback position, this has been a great start to the year. But for the Browns' trade deadline plans, they really shouldn't be looking to spend meaningful assets to try and win this season. They should still look towards the future, as even though they could make the playoffs, the Browns aren't real contenders. However, ESPN's Seth Walder is urging the Browns to make a baffling trade that would be a disaster. That trade idea? A big move to acquire Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins with the hope of improving the QB position for a playoff run this year. ESPN urges Browns to make baffling trade for Kirk Cousins "Who should they target? Raiders QB Kirk Cousins," Walder writes. "The Browns are in an unexpectedly strong position with an actual chance to make the playoffs." The Browns are indeed in position to make a push to earn a playoff spot with Watson as the team's starting quarterback. He's not been great, but he's done enough to keep the Browns in games and lead them to a 5-3 record. But Walder made the case for the Browns to trade for Cousins to improve their odds of making a playoff run. "He would be a temporary solution at quarterback, but that's better than trying to get to the postseason with Watson at QB," Walder writes. Sure, the Browns could acquire Cousins to drastically improve their QB play this season in hopes of making a real playoff push. But to do so, it'd cost them a bit to make that trade. MORE : 4 stats that show how bad Chargers' Justin Herbert has been in 2026 The Raiders don't have to trade Cousins, and they would likely ask for meaningful compensation to give up Cousins. For the Browns, a team trying to rebuild, that kind of trade wouldn't make sense at all. Even if they traded for Cousins, his addition isn't going to make this team a Super Bowl contender. Cousins is a rental QB; why would the Browns ever consider adding him in a trade? It would make no sense. The Browns shouldn't consider a QB addition, and instead should be open to trading away a QB like Dillon Gabriel or Shedeur Sanders. Walder urging the Browns to trade for Cousins would be a horrible idea. There is no scenario in which this kind of move would be a net positive for the Browns, barring a miraculous Super Bowl run, which is very unlikely. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . No. 1 Miami faces its biggest test of the year on Friday, locking horns with No. 11 Notre Dame in South Bend. With star wide receiver Malachi Toney set to undergo surgery on a high ankle sprain he suffered in the lead-up to the contest, the matchup got that much more difficult for the Hurricanes. With the greatest respect to Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith and Oregon State's Jesse Legree, there arguably isn't a wide receiver in the nation who has been more pivotal to its team success than Toney this season. He has accounted for nearly 40 percent of Miami's receiving yards and nearly half of the Hurricanes' receiving touchdowns this season. With the Liberty City native under repair, the Hurricanes are expected to employ a wideout-by-committee approach to its pass game. With that, here's an exhaustive look at all the players who could expect to see increased touches in Toney's absence. He has history with Hurricanes QB Darian Mensah, having caught 72 passes for 1,106 yards and seven touchdowns during his lone season at Duke in 2025. Barkate is the Hurricanes' second-leading receiver thus far, amassing nearly 400 yards on the year. A fifth-year senior with two 1,000-yard seasons under his belt, Barkate figures to be the biggest beneficiary (at least in terms of touches) to Toney's ailment. item.description: Ken Blaze-Imagn Images Browns’ Shedeur Sanders refuses to divulge why he hired an agent ahead of potential Week 9 start appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Questions surrounding Shedeur Sanders ‘ decision to hire an agent last month have sparked speculation about his future in Cleveland. The rookie quarterback is now drawing attention ahead of the Browns’ Week 9 matchup , but he declined to explain the move during Wednesday’s media availability, choosing instead to keep the focus on football . When reporters asked about his decision to hire an agent last month, Sanders quickly pushed back. “What’s that have to do with this game?” Sanders responded. “I’m focused on this game. Anything else really doesn’t matter at this point.” As reported by NBC Sports, the quarterback made the move despite having limited opportunities to renegotiate his contract before the end of the 2027 regular season. Sanders’ decision has fueled speculation about his long-term future in Cleveland. Some have raised the possibility that he could eventually seek a fresh start elsewhere. The timing also drew comparisons to Marvin Harrison Jr., who hired an agent before the Arizona Cardinals traded him to the Houston Texans. However, a potential start on Sunday gives Sanders a chance to showcase his abilities and attract interest from other teams. His performance could also shape Cleveland’s quarterback plans for next season. Sanders completed 120 of 212 passes for 1,400 yards, seven touchdowns, and 10 interceptions in eight games last season, including seven starts. This year, he has appeared in two games but attempted only three passes, completing all of them for two yards. With limited playing time this season, Sunday’s matchup against the Saints gives Sanders a chance to prove himself. A strong performance could strengthen his case for a larger role in Cleveland next season. item.title: Former Arsenal defender visits Barcelona training to observe Hansi Flick’s methods
item.description: Former Arsenal defender visits Barcelona training to observe Hansi Flick’s methods According to Carlos Monfort of SPORT , former Arsenal and Valencia defender Shkodran Mustafi visited the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper to watch the Barcelona first-team players train under Hansi Flick. The former Germany international is currently the assistant manager of the nation’s U21 team. Currently spending a few days in the Catalan capital, he took the opportunity to observe Flick’s methods and how he conducts his sessions. Mustafi observes Barcelona training As per the report, Mustafi visited Barcelona’s training a day after he watched the club’s Juvenil A side in action against Aston Villa in the UEFA Youth League. It was Flick himself who extended the invitation to the 2014 FIFA World Cup winner. The Barcelona manager’s assistant, Marcus Sorg, showed the former defender around and gave him the opportunity to closely observe how the Barça coaching staff operate. Mustafi visited Barcelona’s training facilities. (Photo by Christof Koepsel/Getty Images for DFB) Mustafi called time on his professional career in football in 2024. Not long after, he began his coaching journey, starting off with the Germany U17 national team before becoming Antonio Di Salvo’s assistant with the German U21 national team setup. Just 34 years old, Mustafi is still in the nascent stages of his coaching career. And observing the way Flick and his staff works at Barcelona will have been a learning experience for the former Arsenal defender. Not the first visitor This is not the first time a coach or a manager has visited to observe Barcelona’s training sessions under Flick. In February earlier this year, Edin Terzic paid a visit to the Blaugrana training facilities accompanied by Sebastian Geppert to take a closer look at how Flick works and pick his brains. This came only a few months before Terzic was appointed the manager of Athletic Club, with Geppert joining him at the Basque club as his assistant. Flick doing a brilliant job at Barcelona. (Photo by Pedro Salado/Getty Images) It should not come as a surprise to see coaches wanting to see and learn from Flick and his methods, considering the exceptional work he has done since taking over at Barcelona back in 2024. In two full seasons at the club, the German tactician has already won five trophies, while having the team play an intense, attacking brand of football. Barcelona will be back in action on Sunday when they take on Atletico Madrid in a top-of-the-table La Liga clash away at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano.

item.title: West Ham Sacks Nuno After Home Losses Spark Fan Uproar
item.description: Corey Perrine/Florida Times-Union / USA TODAY NETWORK West Ham has pulled the plug on Nuno Espirito Santo. The club made the move on Tuesday morning after the team lost two straight games at home. This decision comes right after a 3-1 loss to West Brom that left fans shouting for change. The board says a change was needed to keep the club on track. The situation turned ugly fast at the London Stadium. Nuno saw his team give up six goals in just two home matches. Supporters were not even sitting down when they conceded a poor goal during the second half against West Brom. The fans made their feelings clear with loud taunts about the coach being fired. Nuno knew the reality of the situation before the club even announced it. The Reality of Bad Results Football is a simple game built on wins and losses. Improving our game is the sole remedy after suffering defeats at home against Charlton, Southampton and West Brom. That was the honest truth Nuno shared after the final whistle. He admitted that many things went wrong during that disastrous performance. The idea was to start well, but once West Bromwich scored it was very difficult. The team allowed too much time with no cover in the box for the second goal. West Ham sits in eighth place in the Championship table. They are now six points off the top and four points below second place. The board reviewed the start of the season and decided the current path was wrong. The club expressed gratitude for their dedication and hard work throughout their tenure at the club. They wish them all the very best for the future. Leadership Must Step Up Now It takes guts to fire a coach while the season is still young. West Ham owners did not wait for the situation to get worse. They saw the pressure every day and knew they had to fix it. That cannot happen if a team concedes six goals at home in two games. The fans in the stands were right to demand better. A team must try and score first. Every team shares this objective, making it our duty to alter the situation. Nuno said the solution is results and they have to go back to results. The situation is clear: winning games is the only way to change this reality. The club will not let this slide into a long losing streak. Mark Noble, Steve Potts and Gerard Prenderville are set to assume temporary control. They face Cardiff City away on Wednesday night. The game kicks off at 7.45pm and is live on Sky Sports. The new interim team has a clear job to stop the bleeding immediately. West Ham has a tough schedule ahead with games against Blackburn and Preston. The next home match is against Stoke City on November 28. The club must get back on track fast to avoid more trouble. Per Sky Sports , the upcoming fixtures include a trip to Portsmouth on November 24.

item.title: Detroit Lions Urged to Trade for Former First-Round Cornerback
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Detroit Lions may be 5-3 through eight weeks, but that’s only good enough for third place in the NFC North, and a couple of their division rivals are only getting better. The Chicago Bears traded for one of the best defensive tackles in football in Jeffery Simmons. Micah Parsons will return to the Green Bay Packers soon enough, and well, the Lions are still chasing the first-place Minnesota Vikings. While it’s clear that the Lions’ third-ranked scoring offense is good enough to win with, the 23rd-ranked scoring defense has room for improvement. One area that’s been particularly weak is Detroit’s secondary, and now they’ve been connected to a potential upgrade. Related: 1 Bold Prediction for Each Game in NFL Week 9, Including Bills-Vikings Detroit Lions Advised To Reunite With Mike Hughes Via Trade Green Bay Packers running back Marshawn Lloyd (32) is tackled by Atlanta Falcons cornerback Mike Hughes (21) during the first quarter of their game Thursday, Sept. 24, 2026 at Lambeau Field in Green Bay, Wisconsin. While the Lions will eventually get safeties Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph back from injury, their impending return still won’t upgrade the cornerback group. Remember, this is a unit that’s allowed more passing yards and touchdowns than every other team in the NFL. In other words, they’re in dire need of an upgrade, especially if the Lions hope to advance in the playoffs, but first, they have to reach the postseason, something they couldn’t accomplish a year ago. Yet, in Thursday’s column for ESPN, analyst Bill Barnwell urged the Lions to consider pursuing a reunion with former Detroit cornerback Mike Hughes, who now plays for the Atlanta Falcons, but has fallen out of favor as of late. “Veteran cornerback Mike Hughes was with a very different version of this Lions team in 2022 before leaving for the Falcons in free agency. He has started most of his time there, but after A.J. Terrell Jr. returned from injured reserve, Hughes has been in a reserve role, including a season-low eight defensive snaps during last week’s loss to the Buccaneers. He wouldn’t be an obvious upgrade on any of the options in Detroit, but the 29-year-old has been a reliable low-end starter at corner for most of his time in Atlanta.” Bill Barnwell on Detroit Lions Trade for Mike Hughes Trading for Hughes certainly wouldn’t immediately solve all of the Lions’ problems in the secondary. However, for a team that’s in third place of the division, the former first-round pick could potentially be a low-cost upgrade that still helps the defense improve. In an uncertain time where a playoff spot is not guaranteed, this may not be the year for the Lions to swing for the fences by parting with precious draft capital, which is why a smaller, more inexpensive upgrade like Hughes could appeal more to Detroit’s front office. item.title: Lewis Hamilton admits his outspoken nature has made Ferrari move more difficult
item.description: Motorsport photo Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton has admitted that his outspoken approach has made it harder for him to fit in at Ferrari alongside Charles Leclerc , explaining that "it’s not so easy having someone like me come into a team." Hamilton, who joined the Maranello outfit at the start of the 2025 season, clashed with Leclerc on the opening lap of last weekend's Mexican Grand Prix. Leclerc attempted to overtake Hamilton, who started from pole position, but both drivers ran off the track. Hamilton dropped from first to third behind Max Verstappen as a result, and Leclerc was handed a five-second penalty. While speaking to the media after the race in Mexico City, the Briton called for "serious talks" within the team and has now spoken about the situation again in Brazil. "He’s been here a long time," Hamilton said when asked whether Leclerc's long-standing relationship with Ferrari had made it harder for him to settle into the team. "Eight years and had nine wins with the team. He is very much embedded within the team, and I know that it would always be a challenge. Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari "I’ve always respected that, and I’ve approached the team and really worked hard to build a good relationship with Charles and bridge the gap and make sure that we’re harmonious and work hard together. Always tried to be respectful." He explained why he believes his arrival at Ferrari was always going to make some within the team cautious. "Naturally, it’s not so easy having someone like me come into a team, because I’m very outspoken and I push and push and push. Push for so many changes," he added. "And I’m going to be pushing for more. And as long as I’m here, that’s how it’s going to be. "I’m here to win, and to be able to win, you have to work with everyone around you. You have to push, and I have to push. I have to be pushed also to elevate. We can all always elevate and be better, and I truly believe that this team can be fighting for the championship next year." item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers are up for three Silver Slugger awards in 2026, hoping to bring home some hardware after a successful regular season. The Dodgers, despite their age and injuries, found a way to win 100 games this season, which was no small feat, as the catcher room was decimated by injuries and the starting rotation was never fully healthy at any point this year. LA overcame all of this with a steady stream of offense in the first half of the season, led by their two Silver Slugger nominees. Muncy is in a good spot to take home the award, as he leads the National League in wRC+ among third basemen, ranks second in above-average offensive rating behind Alex Bregman, and leads the NL in weighted on-base average and slugging. Muncy’s rival will be Bregman, who leads the league in home runs and RBIs and has a higher offensive rating, per FanGraphs.
